body:
Fix round on `1cca2236` (head 31b8e2d2 + one commit `build(process): ...`; no merge of main, PROCESS_VERSION stays 31). Still a draft. Title is now `build(process): ...`; the body says `Changelog: none`.

**1. Octopus merge keeps a review - fixed.** `xtask/src/merge_delta.rs` checks `parents.len() > 2` before the second-parent test: a commit with more than two parents is NEW CODE (note: `octopus merge (N parents)`). `merge_plan_git.rs` only reads the remerge-diff of a two-parent merge, so git's skipped octopus warning is never triggered. Pinned by `delta_octopus_merge_of_main_is_new_code_even_with_main_second` (three-parent `Commit`, main second, empty remerge-diff: NEW CODE).

**2. GitHub `mergeable` is read - fixed.** `gh pr list` now also returns `mergeable`. Pure decision table `merge_plan::base_state(mergeable, git_clean)`: git clean + CONFLICTING = `GithubOnly` (deferred; wave 2 kind `plain refresh`, why names the merge-base count, `git merge-base --all`); git clean + MERGEABLE/UNKNOWN = `Sim`; git conflict = `Conflict`. UNKNOWN is re-read 6 times, 5 s apart; a PR still UNKNOWN is named in a `WARNING:` line above the plan. Pinned by `base_state_is_the_git_and_github_decision_table`, `github_conflict_git_does_not_see_is_a_plain_refresh_not_wave_one`, `a_child_of_a_github_only_parent_waits_too`, `unknown_mergeable_is_listed_and_still_planned_as_git_says`.

**3. Ready/draft flow - decided once, same in all four places.** AGENTS.md "Every PR opens as a draft" (superseded note, quote kept, authority cited as the question-dialog decision "Refresh only at merge time", issue #1221): a SAME refresh (merge of main, no hand edits) of a ready PR is pushed without the draft round-trip; a refresh with hand edits goes draft, push, review. In both cases the **merging session** runs `gh pr ready <N>` right before merging, with one PR comment naming the class (SAME / MECHANICAL / DELTA) and the review it stands on; nothing is pushed after that. The same sentence is in `resolve-conflicts` section 0 and in `review-prs` 2b (orange still turns our PR to draft; the review skill never flags ready). The quoted maintainer sentence "Once its been flagged ready to review no more pushes should be performed" is kept verbatim.

**4. Contributor-mode text - fixed.** AGENTS.md "Conflicted PRs are re-merged by their author": contributor mode is now "for the PR the merge batch is about to merge, the one PR the author names, or one the author is pushing a review fix to anyway (not every conflicting PR at once)". The quote "comment 'ready for a re-check'" stays.

**Search for any other sentence that refreshes early or delta-reviews every merge of main** (`grep -n -i -E "refresh|merge main|merge origin/main|merge upstream/main|delta|gh repo view|flagged ready|ready for review|pr ready|no more pushes"` over AGENTS.md, `.claude/agents/PR-reviewer.md`, `.claude/skills/resolve-conflicts/SKILL.md`, `.claude/skills/review-prs/SKILL.md`). Every hit now reads as merge-time or as a plain procedure: AGENTS "Refresh only at merge time" and its clean-merge sibling; the cut step 1 (merge at merge time, in planner order); the snapshot "refresh" lines (about PNGs, not PRs); the resolve-conflicts procedure steps (`git merge upstream/main`, commit message); review-prs 2b and PR-reviewer step 1 (SAME is skipped, the rest reviewed). No sentence delta-reviews every merge of main.

**Cheap notes.** Owner lookup names the base repo: `gh repo view NeoTech/Camcraft --json owner` in AGENTS "Only the owner's reviews count", PR-reviewer step 1, review-prs step 1 (already). The planner deletes `refs/merge-plan/<N>` after each run, also when planning fails (`cleanup_refs`). The test helper `run` calls `expect`, so a planner error fails the test with its message and never becomes an empty plan (`planner_error_is_returned_not_hidden`).

**Gate.** `cargo xtask gate quick --base origin/main`: green on its run after the fixes (xtask unit tests). `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings`: first run failed on `clippy::enum_variant_names` (`Mergeable::Mergeable`); renamed the variant to `Clean`; clean now. `cargo test -p xtask --bin xtask merge`: 22 passed.

**merge-plan for real (read-only, from the worktree):**

```
$ cargo xtask merge-plan 1216 1131 1136 1156
base 37482923

WAVE 1 - merge in this order; no head moves, so no refresh and no delta review (4):
  #1216  feat(ui): tool kind glyphs on the Tool library catalog rows and the tool picker
  #1131  feat(edm): sinker burn to depth with a single electrode
  #1136  feat(edm): sinker rough and finish with undersize from their conditions
  #1156  feat(sinker): generate an electrode from a cavity's picked faces
```

These four are **not** plain refreshes on today's main: `gh pr view` reports all four `mergeable=MERGEABLE`, `state=CLEAN` at base 37482923 (they were CONFLICTING at 7580cd21, as the review says). So the planner is right to put them in wave 1. I could not show them as plain refreshes live. Note that #1131, #1136 and #1156 are stacked on #1208 (their base branch), so with #1208 in the set they wait behind it, as the changed-parent rule says:

```
$ cargo xtask merge-plan 1216 1131 1136 1156 1235 1228 1219 1218 1210 1208
WAVE 1 (1): #1216
WAVE 2 (9): #1208 [by hand] ... #1210 [by hand] ... #1218 [by hand] ... #1228 [by hand] ... #1219 [by hand] ...
  #1131 [clean after wave 1] its parent #1208 is not in wave 1
  #1136 [clean after wave 1] its parent #1208 is not in wave 1
  #1156 [clean after wave 1] its parent #1208 is not in wave 1
  #1235 [by hand] ...
```

I also ran the planner on all 38 open PRs GitHub reports CONFLICTING right now: none is git-clean, so there is no live plain refresh to show. The GitHub-only path is covered by the unit tests above.

Searched and unchanged: AGENTS.md "Conflicted PRs" wave text, the cut step 1 (merge at merge time, planner order), "Overlapping issues stack" (merge of origin/main at merge time, consistent).

**Estimated agent cost to merge-ready:** ~$1.13 (530k tokens)
| Run | Model | Tokens | Est. cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| work + fix round (cumulative) | Haiku 5.5 | 337k | ~$0.05 |
| review + re-review (cumulative) | Opus 5.5 | 193k | ~$1.08 |
Blended upper estimate (90 % input / 10 % output at list price; cache reads make the real cost lower). Main-session coordination isn't counted.

Effort: effort:high (not escalated). Agent-tier trial, issue 10. Held unmerged while main is frozen for the conflict-clearing pass; merges when it thaws (PROCESS_VERSION 31, or the next free number then).
